title: Draft: WIP: TLS: Add option to select keylog directory
description:
Add an option in Preferences -> Protocols -> TLS to select a directory
containing keylog files. All of the files in the directory will be used
to decrypt TLS packets. Closes #19069.

WIP: TLS: Add option to select keylog directory

Add an option in Preferences -> Protocols -> TLS to select a directory
containing keylog files. All of the files in the directory will be used
to decrypt TLS packets. Closes #19069.
